name: Dolphin PR #14837: VideoCommon: separate out reinterpret and palette texture creation from rendering + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14837`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14837](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14837)
**Title:** VideoCommon: separate out reinterpret and palette texture creation from rendering
**Author:** [@iwubcode](https://github.com/iwubcode)

#### PR Description
Late last year I started working on a new feature that required Dolphin to think about how it renders in a different way. In order to prepare for that, I will be creating some PRs that restructure or refactor our existing code.

This PR is for the texture cache. All it does is separate out the rendering of palette and reinterpret paths from the actual texture entry creation.  This one isn't very exciting but I swear there's more excitement coming!

Functionality should not change with these PRs. I did some mild testing but fifo ci should hopefully confirm if any changes slipped through.

This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

# Packages

## Targets

Each build is optimized for a specific architecture and uses a specific compiler.

- **arm64-v8a**: For devices that use the armv8-a instruction set; e.g. Snapdragon X, all Android devices, and Apple Silicon Macs.
- **x86_64**: For devices that use the x86_64 instruction set; this is exclusively used by Intel and AMD CPUs and is only found on desktops.
- **v3**: For devices that use the x86_64-v3 instruction set or newer; this is found on Ryzen, Intel 4th Generation (Haswell), and newer.

### PGO

PGO builds usually perform ~10-30% better than standard builds, and are thus generally recommended for all users.

## Linux

Linux packages are distributed via AppImage.
[zsync](https://zsync.moria.org.uk/) files are provided for easier updating, such as via
[AM](https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM).

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
|------------|----------|-----------|-------|
| amd64 | [Standard AppImage](./eden-linux-standard-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-standard-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage.zsync)) | [PGO AppImage](./eden-linux-pgo-clang-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-pgo-clang-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage.zsync)) |  |
| Legacy amd64 | [Standard AppImage](./eden-linux-legacy-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-legacy-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage.zsync)) |  | Pre-Ryzen or Haswell CPUs (expect sadness) |
| Steam Deck | [Standard AppImage](./eden-linux-steamdeck-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-steamdeck-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage.zsync)) |  | Zen 2 |
| Zen 4 | [Standard AppImage](./eden-linux-rog-ally-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-rog-ally-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.AppImage.zsync)) |  | Zen 4 (AMD Z1/Z2, ROG Ally X, Legion Go S) |
| ARM (aarch64) | [Standard AppImage](./eden-linux-standard-gcc-v858f9e5aea-aarch64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-standard-gcc-v858f9e5aea-aarch64.AppImage.zsync)) | [PGO AppImage](./eden-linux-pgo-clang-v858f9e5aea-aarch64.AppImage) ([zsync](./eden-linux-pgo-clang-v858f9e5aea-aarch64.AppImage.zsync)) |  |

## Windows

Windows packages are in-place zip files. Setup files are soon to come.

| Build Type | Standard | PGO (Recommended) | Notes |
|------------|----------|-------------------|-------|
| amd64 (MSVC) | [MSVC zip](./eden-windows-standard-msvc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.zip) |  | Use if you encounter graphical issues on other builds (e.g. Pokemon Scarlet & Violet) |
| x86_64 v3 | [Standard zip](./eden-windows-standard-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.zip) | [PGO zip](./eden-windows-pgo-clang-v858f9e5aea-amd64.zip) | Built with MinGW. Requires Ryzen, 4th gen Intel, or newer |
| Zen 4 | [Standard zip](./eden-windows-rog-ally-gcc-v858f9e5aea-amd64.zip) |  | Requires Zen 4 or newer (e.g. ROG Ally X, Legion Go S). Incompatible with Intel |
| arm64-v8a | [Standard zip](./eden-windows-standard-clang-v858f9e5aea-aarch64.zip) | [PGO zip](./eden-windows-pgo-clang-v858f9e5aea-aarch64.zip) | Snapdragon devices |

## Android

| Build  | Notes |
|--------|-------|
| [Standard APK](./eden-android-standard-v858f9e5aea-arm64-v8a.apk) | The standard build. Most users should use this. |
| [Genshin Spoof APK](./eden-android-optimized-v858f9e5aea-arm64-v8a.apk) | Spoofs Eden as Genshin Impact, which may enable optimizations/frame generation on some flagship devices. |
| [Legacy APK](./eden-android-legacy-v858f9e5aea-arm64-v8a.apk) | For Snapdragon 865 and other unsupported chipsets |
| [ChromeOS APK](./eden-android-chromeos-v858f9e5aea-x86_64.apk) | For Chromebooks and x86_64 Android devices |

## macOS

macOS comes in a DMG image. These builds are currently experimental, and you should expect major graphical glitches and crashes.
In order to run the app, you *may* need to go to System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Security -> Allow untrusted app.

- [macOS DMG](./eden-macos-v858f9e5aea-universal.dmg)

## Torrent

A torrent containing all artifacts. To use this, simply download the torrent and import it into your
favorite torrent client (BitTorrent only!), and artifacts will be downloaded automatically.
